description: This source file defines the UtilTimer class in the org.apache.ofbiz.base.util package. The class provides timer utility functions to measure elapsed time, generate timing reports, and manage timers with named instances. It supports starting, retrieving, logging, and closing timers, with some static management features.

classes.name: UtilTimer
classes.description: Utility class for timing operations, including starting timers, generating timing reports, and managing static timer instances.

methods.name: makeTimer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new UtilTimer instance, starting it if specified.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a named static UtilTimer instance, optionally enabling logging.

methods.name: timerLog
methods.description: Logs a message with the specified timer name, starting the timer if it is not already running.

methods.name: closeTimer
methods.description: Removes and stops the named timer, optionally logging a final message.
